summary: Iteration 2 (auth + Stripe + AI chat + admin dashboard) fully verified. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests pass covering JWT login (success/wrong pass/unknown), /api/auth/me via cookie + bearer, admin bookings/payments (401 unauth, 200 authed), PATCH booking status (200 update persisted, 404 for missing), Google invalid session (401), Claude streaming chat (streamed >20 chars), Stripe checkout returns checkout.stripe.com URL + cs_ session_id, payment status endpoint (pending/paid + 404). Frontend Playwright: /admin redirects to /admin/login when unauth (PASS); JWT login via admin-login-btn lands on DISPATCH CONTROL ROOM with 4 stat cards and 3 booking rows; admin-logout returns to /admin/login. Homepage chat-toggle opens panel, chat-send streams ARC assistant response into chat-msg-assistant (received: 'Hi, I'm ARC — your AI repair concierge...'). buy-now-1 click triggers /api/payments/checkout (200) and browser navigates to Stripe checkout (skeleton visible).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L36: CORS allow_origins now correctly uses FRONTEND_URL when set — good improvement over iteration 1.
server.py L104 get_current_admin: session_token expiry parses ISO string OK, but consider unifying storage as datetime for cleaner code.
server.py L321: bad Stripe lookup_key returns 500 with detail — arguably should be 400/404 (client error, not server). Minor UX nit.
server.py L292: LlmChat instantiated per-request (fine) but chat streaming inserts assistant message only after full stream — an aborted client connection would drop the log. Consider try/finally.
server.py: single 370-line backend file is acceptable; if more features land, split into routers (auth, admin, chat, payments).

server.py L214: /api/auth/login returns token in body AND sets httpOnly cookie — returning the token in body reduces the value of httpOnly (XSS could exfiltrate the body). If frontend only needs cookie, drop token from body.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_Dispatch booking created via /api/bookings then transitioned to 'dispatched' via PATCH; Stripe checkout session created (test-mode, not paid).
